entry_fill_price: the first on-chain curve read after detection (the same getMultipleAccounts context that passed the security filters). exit_rule: identical in every arm — the Round 6 4-mode ladder: SL -10% before TP1/rocket, TP1 +30% sells 50%, rocket bypass +50%, trail 0.85x after +10%, shelf 4.5 s, no-progress 5 s, timeouts 35/90 s

portfolio_b1_narrow.why: the only band with non-negative EV at 5-10 s in all three runs (+0.47/+1.42/+1.82 %), and better on the real ladder in run3/run5 (-11.1/-7.2 vs -23.7/-20.1); risk: three rockets carried the 1-2.5 band in run6

portfolio_b2_birth.why: the only filter with a stable sign 4/4 on a fixed exit, and identical to dev_buy <= 1 SOL; risk: on the run6 ladder it lost (-507 RUB vs +755 RUB for birth > 31)

portfolio_b3_t0.why: the only arm whose expected gain is arithmetic: it enters on the first curve read (A waits for a 0.10 SOL impulse) and so does not pay the measured 1.416 % entry_fill_premium (~7 RUB on 500 RUB); it also sees 438 coins instead of 167 inside the same birth band, with the same 6.6 % rocket share (60 s window). Risk: entering without an impulse confirmation

run7_expectation.portfolio_b1_narrow: +1..+6 RUB/trade vs A (better in 3/3 runs on a fixed exit and in run3/run5 on the ladder; the narrow band cuts the flow 1.8x)

run7_expectation.portfolio_b3_t0: +3..+9 RUB from removing the 1.416 % entry premium (~7 RUB on 500 RUB); EV itself is neutral

run7_decision_rule: an arm confirms its hypothesis iff the PAIRED mean(arm - A) >= +8 RUB on the coins both arms traded, the 98.75 % bootstrap CI (Bonferroni over three hypotheses, alpha 0.0125) excludes 0, and the sign is the same in both halves of the run
run7_power: paired sd ~98 RUB, ~56 trades/hour per arm: the CI half width is ~15 RUB at ~165 pairs, so a 3-hour run cannot resolve anything below ~15 RUB/trade, and the +8 RUB threshold needs ~1 700 pairs after Bonferroni, i.e. ~21 h at this flow
run7_p0_accepted: early_stop_reason = null, unrecovered RPC failures <= 2 %, dropped_events = 0, write_errors = 0, requests_per_sec <= 1.8, security_fail_skipped_deep > 0, no shadow profiles, enrich.csv written
run7_p0_fixes: P0-2 verdict resolved inside the offset loop (run6 read every offset because the verdict was set after observe_candidate); ticks carry price_usd instead of a rouble price divided by sol_usd; security_fail_reasons use the LAST reason (the verdict, not the passed check); ticks gain mark_prev_pct/step_gap_pp/mark_gap_ms and exit_kind; observation offsets 0/5/15/60, with the 60 s read taken for a hash-selected third of the coins; entry_lag_ms replaces the "floor violations" counter that measured the model, not a failure
run7_not_doing: no exit change in any arm, no delta > 2.5 arm (EV@15 -9.25/-5.84/-5.54 % in three runs and no extra rockets inside A's birth band), no creator gate live (worse than average in 4/4 samples), no fourth experimental arm, no band tuning mid-run

stop_list: прогон останавливается только по четырём причинам: telemetry dropped_events/write_errors > 0; доля НЕИСПРАВЛЕННЫХ ошибок RPC (после 3 ретраев 0.2/0.5/1.2 c + джиттер, с учётом Retry-After) > 2% за 10 мин или p95 > 1000 мс пять минут подряд; профиль без входов 30 мин при растущем entry_state; остаток квоты Helius < 10% или < 2 ГБ на диске. portfolio_b3_t0.entry_fill_price: the first on-chain curve read after detection (the same getMultipleAccounts context that passed the security filters). The WSS packet price is never used for a fill; entry_lag_ms records how old the read was and entry_premium_pct compares the entry mid with the coin t0 mid of that read

portfolio_b1_narrow.why: the only band with non-negative EV at 5-10 s in all three runs (+0.47/+1.42/+1.82 %), and better on the real ladder in run3/run5 (-11.1/-7.2 vs -23.7/-20.1); risk: three rockets carried the 1-2.5 band in run6

portfolio_b2_birth.why: the only filter with a stable sign 4/4 on a fixed exit, and identical to dev_buy <= 1 SOL; risk: on the run6 ladder it lost (-507 RUB vs +755 RUB for birth > 31)

portfolio_b3_t0.why: the only arm whose expected gain is arithmetic: it enters on the first curve read (A waits for a 0.10 SOL impulse) and so does not pay the measured 1.416 % entry_fill_premium (~7 RUB on 500 RUB); it also sees 438 coins instead of 167 inside the same birth band, with the same 6.6 % rocket share (60 s window). Risk: entering without an impulse confirmation

run7_expectation.portfolio_b1_narrow: +1..+6 RUB/trade vs A (better in 3/3 runs on a fixed exit and in run3/run5 on the ladder; the narrow band cuts the flow 1.8x)
run7_expectation.portfolio_b2_birth: -8..+8 RUB (model says better in 2/3 runs, the run6 ladder lost 15.7 RUB/trade: the run decides)
run7_expectation.portfolio_b3_t0: +3..+9 RUB from removing the 1.416 % entry premium (~7 RUB on 500 RUB); EV itself is neutral

portfolio_b3_t0.run7_decision_rule: an arm confirms its hypothesis iff the PAIRED mean(arm - A) >= +8 RUB on the coins both arms traded, the 98.75 % bootstrap CI (Bonferroni over three hypotheses, alpha 0.0125) excludes 0, and the sign is the same in both halves of the run
portfolio_b3_t0.run7_power: paired sd ~98 RUB, ~56 trades/hour per arm: the CI half width is ~15 RUB at ~165 pairs, so a 3-hour run cannot resolve anything below ~15 RUB/trade, and the +8 RUB threshold needs ~1 700 pairs after Bonferroni, i.e. ~21 h at this flow
portfolio_b3_t0.run7_p0_accepted: early_stop_reason = null, unrecovered RPC failures <= 2 %, dropped_events = 0, write_errors = 0, requests_per_sec <= 1.8, security_fail_skipped_deep > 0, no shadow profiles, enrich.csv written
portfolio_b3_t0.run7_p0_fixes: P0-2 verdict resolved inside the offset loop (run6 read every offset because the verdict was set after observe_candidate); ticks carry price_usd instead of a rouble price divided by sol_usd; security_fail_reasons use the LAST reason (the verdict, not the passed check); ticks gain mark_prev_pct/step_gap_pp/mark_gap_ms and exit_kind; observation offsets 0/5/15/60, with the 60 s read taken for a hash-selected third of the coins; entry_lag_ms replaces the "floor violations" counter that measured the model, not a failure
portfolio_b3_t0.run7_not_doing: no exit change in any arm, no delta > 2.5 arm (EV@15 -9.25/-5.84/-5.54 % in three runs and no extra rockets inside A's birth band), no creator gate live (worse than average in 4/4 samples), no fourth experimental arm, no band tuning mid-run
portfolio_b3_t0.bank_rule: каждый профиль ведёт свой кэш; если перед входом cash < 500 ₽, книга пополняется до 1500 ₽ и сделка открывается. Ставка 500 ₽, 3 слота и все входы/выходы не меняются — пополнение влияет только на «торговать / не торговать». Счётчик top_ups остаётся метрикой
portfolio_b3_t0.stop_list: прогон останавливается только по четырём причинам: telemetry dropped_events/write_errors > 0; доля НЕИСПРАВЛЕННЫХ ошибок RPC (после 3 ретраев 0.2/0.5/1.2 c + джиттер, с учётом Retry-After) > 2% за 10 мин или p95 > 1000 мс пять минут подряд; профиль без входов 30 мин при растущем entry_state; остаток квоты Helius < 10% или < 2 ГБ на диске. Порог 2% поднимать запрещено. PnL не является причиной остановки
portfolio_b3_t0.creator_probe: telemetry only; no entry gate in any arm

rpc.latency_policy: measure actual latency/errors; no SLA or coverage promise

fees.source: on-chain Pump Global + FeeConfig; quote fills use SDK integer math
fees.on_chain_curve_fees: included in out_amount_raw; reported separately from network fees

filters.creator_gate_note: the creator gate lost against the average in 4/4 independent samples (run3 -6.29 %, run5 -4.77 %, run6 both halves -4.01 / -6.44 % vs -2.99/-2.86/-4.11/-4.51) and is not used anywhere

observation_policy: scheduled real Pump curve RPC reads; no interpolation or DexScreener/GeckoTerminal fallback for Pump.fun

accounting.network_fees: tracked separately; deducted from realized returns and shown as open fee liability
